q: Compare: residential DATRC physical plant — Annex D (2016) vs DC 2019-0377?
n: The 2019 checklist is the newer rule. Remember this: DATRC "1-8 to sleep, 1-10 to bathe": toilet/bath ratio 1:8 in the checklist, and 1 bathroom-toilet-lavatory per 10 patients in Annex D. Beds 1 m apart; bunk beds need 1 m headroom. DTL walls tiled 1.22 m, counters 400 mm, ceiling 2.40 m.

q: True or false: DATRC bathrooms and toilets for patients may be provided with locks.
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex D (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item c
n: Only those for the exclusive use of administrative staff may have locks.
